assertions.claim: Stranger pairs took turns answering three sets of 36 progressively deeper questions; after 45 minutes closeness clearly exceeded the equal-time small-talk control
assertions.cn_span: 轮流回答三组由浅入深、共 36 道问题，45 分钟后彼此的亲近感明显高于闲聊同样时长的对照组

assertions.claim: Closeness even exceeded the students' average rating of their closest real relationships
assertions.cn_span: 甚至高过那批学生对自己现实中最亲密关系的平均打分

assertions.claim: What works is both sides taking turns telling deeper truths, not conversational techniques
assertions.cn_span: 起作用的是两边轮流、一层层往深里说真话，不是话术

assertions.claim: It measured only short-term closeness, not whether a long-term relationship can develop
assertions.cn_span: 它测的只是短时间内的亲近感，不代表能发展成长期关系

assertions.claim: Closeness comes from escalating two-way self-disclosure, not techniques, scripts or one-sided presentation
assertions.cn_span: 亲近感来自逐步升级的双向自我披露，而不是话术、套路或单方面表现
